verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official MCP server that exposes its own data to external AI clients (rollbar-docs-18, rollbar-probe-3), but there is no evidence that Rollbar itself can act as an MCP client—i.e., that a user can plug external MCP servers into Rollbar (or its Resolve AI agent) so it can call their tools. The axis is plausible given Rollbar's AI agent feature, but no supporting evidence exists.
